resolution.note: first-ten --report prints PASS on the labelled synthetic cohort fixture; FAIL and INSUFFICIENT proven by CLI tests

title: Measure inherited standards on each adopter's first ten tasks against a static control
body:
Astra audit top-2 (B1/B2 verified): there is no measurement of what inherited standards change on an adopter's first ten tasks against a matched static control.
Files: evals/adoption/first-ten.ts
Outcome: node evals/adoption/first-ten.ts --report compares the first ten consecutive tasks per adopter with paired static-control replays from the same pre-task SHA and prints PASS, FAIL or INSUFFICIENT against frozen thresholds.
Proof: node evals/adoption/first-ten.ts --report prints one of PASS/FAIL/INSUFFICIENT on a recorded cohort fixture.
